policy.catalogBoundary: Collection and folder descriptions remain separate from normalized menu-item counts.
policy.mediaBoundary: MenuGraph only renders media when a source record exposes a reusable public asset; otherwise the record is metadata-only.
policy.naraBoundary: Persistent NARA snapshots should come from NARA bulk data, not cached API responses. Runtime API access requires a user-supplied key.

collections.title: Virginia Mericle Menu Collection
collections.description: More than 4,000 restaurant menus collected mainly by writing to U.S. restaurants, with strong state and country arrangement and useful postmark or correspondence context.
collections.rights: SOVA descriptive metadata is CC0; item media rights may vary.

collections.title: Warshaw Collection of Business Americana — Menus
collections.description: Approximately 700 menus spanning restaurants, railways, ships, holidays, special events, and souvenir forms; the finding aid notes digital images for some material.
collections.rights: SOVA descriptive metadata is CC0; item media rights may vary.

collections.title: Archives Center Menu Collection
collections.description: A mid-century-heavy menu collection with strong California and Los Angeles coverage, cruise-ship material, colorful imagery, themed designs, and unusual physical formats.
collections.rights: Descriptive metadata is reusable; item media rights may vary.

collections.title: John D. Crimmins Collection
collections.description: Event, banquet, civic, political, Irish-American, and Catholic menus with related programs, invitations, and seating material.
collections.rights: Descriptive metadata is reusable; item media rights may vary.

collections.title: Mariano Floresca Papers — Presidential Yacht and Key West Menus
collections.description: Three folders of menus from President Truman's U.S.S. Williamsburg and Key West trips in the Mariano Floresca Papers.
collections.rights: U.S. government works may be public domain; donated or commercial material can retain copyright.

collections.title: Presidential and Ceremonial Menu Discovery Set
collections.description: A curated discovery layer for presidential-library, White House, state-dinner, military, hospital, and other official dining records across NARA holdings.
collections.rights: Rights vary by creating office, donor, and included commercial material.
